default_period: last 28 complete days versus preceding 28 complete days

panels.name: Organic acquisition
panels.note: Returning users and engaged sessions use native GA4 definitions, not custom event totals.

panels.name: Search opportunity
panels.source: Google Search Console Site Impression and URL Impression, separate tables
panels.candidate_filter: impressions > 1000 AND CTR < 0.03; position 4–20 examined separately
panels.aggregation: CTR=sum(clicks)/sum(impressions); position impression weighted. Preserve anonymised-query coverage limitations.

panels.name: Confirmed outcomes
notes: newsletter_signup and generate_lead only after genuine confirmation
purchase only verified provider transactions; donation_click in separate engagement panel
Do not sum repeated micro-actions as distinct subscribers or donors

panels.name: Indexing and CWV
panels.source: Dated Search Console exports and live field reports
panels.note: Coverage/field exports separate from Search Analytics connector; no field samples means unknown.

panels.name: Bing search
panels.source: Verified Bing Webmaster API or controlled exports

join_policy: Normalise protocol, host, trailing slash and canonical path. Aggregate each source before joins; do not join page-query-country-device rows directly to GA4 sessions. Report mismatched dates, attribution and privacy coverage.
access: Owner-approved viewers; keep credentials in approved connectors, never client JavaScript or the public repository.
